original_question: Dolly has two books. Pandora has one. If both Dolly and Pandora read each others' books as well as their own, how many books will they collectively read by the end?
question_template: {name_female_1, Dolly} has {num_text_1, two} books. {name_female_2, Pandora} has {num_text_2, one}. If both {name_female_1, Dolly} and {name_female_2, Pandora} read each others' books as well as their own, how many books will they collectively read by the end?
question_solution: answer = 2 * (f1 + f2)   # f1 and f2 are the numeric values of num_text_1 and num_text_2
